name: ProxyPay
tagline: Approves card payments only when your phone is near the point of sale, with MFA when it is close but not exact.
problem: Fraud detection is reactive and losses are large, the team says.
solution: Matches the phone's live location to the terminal at payment time: nearby approves, far blocks, borderline triggers MFA; runs on Arm-based cloud servers.
demo_moment: Team-described: pay with the phone nearby, then try from far away.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of Arm” among 160 submissions.
Prevents fraud before it happens rather than after.

lessons: A simple physical signal can beat a complex model.
